decisionSummary: The Aug 21 dev-publish v24/2.0.31 source is canonical. It is the direct forward fix from the reviewed rich miniPaint/Jinn peer line: it removes the unavailable sandbox mkdir invocation that prevented a new Paint grain from starting, retains the scoped read-only GrainContext integration for Jinn and the full PowerBox-gated image editor, and keeps candidate-bound metadata aligned with the signed Bureau Paint identity. Main remains its reviewed stable ancestor; the divergent metadata and historical publish/codex refs are older package or release lines with no newer runnable Paint source.

clean tracked dev-publish source at the selected commit passed release-inputs and the sandbox-launcher mutation control
make build and make test passed, including 234 Python and integration tests
